findings.evidence: Lines 88,147,180,213 `@[expose]`; every use path (e.g. orthogonalToDiffSphere_apply at 221, coe_unitSphereDiffeomorph_apply at 154) goes through lemmas, not unfolding.
findings.fix: Drop `@[expose]` on all four defs; keep bodies hidden and rely on the characteristic lemmas. For the `rfl` characteristic lemmas (coe_unitSphereEquiv_apply, unitSphereEquiv_symm/_refl, coe_unitSphereDiffeomorph_apply, _toEquiv, _symm, unitSphereDiffHom_apply, orthogonalToDiffSphere_apply) use `:= (rfl)` so consumers do not depend on defeq.
findings.issue: `unitSphereEquiv`, `unitSphereDiffeomorph` (148), `unitSphereDiffHom` (181), and `orthogonalToDiffSphere` (214) all carry `@[expose]`, but each has a full `_apply`/`coe_`/`_symm` characterization and no downstream consumer must unfold or compute their bodies.

findings.evidence: Docstring line 211 asserts injectivity; only `unitSphereDiffHom_injective` (194) exists.
findings.fix: Add `orthogonalToDiffSphere_injective : Function.Injective (orthogonalToDiffSphere n m)` (immediate from `unitSphereDiffHom_injective` via `orthogonalToDiffSphere_apply`).
findings.issue: `orthogonalToDiffSphere`'s docstring claims O(n+1) is realised as a subgroup (injectivity), but injectivity is provided only as `unitSphereDiffHom_injective`; the named roadmap deliverable has no injectivity lemma of its own.

summary: Construction is correct and the characteristic API is complete and mostly well-annotated, but all four definitions expose their bodies without any consumer needing to unfold, and the named deliverable's advertised injectivity is not stated about the deliverable itself.
